newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady but undertone weak.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady but undertone weak.

text.p: Singapore bunker prices held steady with one major seen very aggressive, offering at very competitive levels, traders said on Tuesday.

Bunker 380-cst supplies were quoted at $95-96 per tonne, 180-cst at $102 per tonne. A European major has been offering at a very low level, moving at below $95 for 380-cst, traders said. They said the major is trying to dispose of its fuel oil stocks in the bunker market, anticipating a down trend in cargo prices. "But demand is slow," said one seller.
MDO and gas oil also maintained their levels, quoted at around $163-$175 and $173-$180 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3082)
